items.title: Integrate cell03-shards helpers into the real B-991d Cell 03 provider runner
items.context: Replace the serial single-ledger-append execution path with shard-planned parallel execution that consumes B-e1f6 plan.mjs / shard-runner.mjs. Acceptance: the real runner writes shard-local outputs and never appends directly to the canonical cell03-rows.jsonl during parallel execution.

items.title: Record per-attempt provider accounting on every real row
items.context: Every real (non-fixture) provider row must carry attemptId, runId, and shardId/shardIndex plus executionWindowId, not just the fixture markers B-e1f6 emits. Acceptance: each real row is uniquely attributable to one provider attempt within one shard and one execution window.

items.title: Record provider-reported usage per attempt into a shard-local usage ledger
items.context: Capture provider-reported token usage per attempt (keyed by attemptId) into an append-only shard-local usage ledger, not a single shared counter. Acceptance: usage for a shard is reconstructable from its shard-local ledger alone.

items.title: Guarantee retry / failed / superseded attempts are not double-counted
items.context: Retried, failed, and superseded attempts must not double-count in usage totals or final row counts; only the final surviving attempt per cellKey counts. Acceptance: a fixture with retried/failed/superseded attempts yields the same usage and row totals as a single-attempt run.

items.title: Protect the cumulative usage total (68,397,574 tokens) with shard-local usage ledgers
items.context: The cumulative usage aggregate must be derived by summing validated shard-local usage ledgers so parallel real runs cannot pollute or race the aggregate. Acceptance: parallel shard runs produce an aggregate equal to the sum of per-shard ledgers with no lost or double-counted attempts.

items.title: Add a result-writer that merges validated shard outputs into the formal Cell 03 result ledger
items.context: Provide a result-writer/integration step that merges validated shard outputs into cell03-rows.jsonl using B-e1f6 merge-validation guarantees (binding/digest/duplicate/missing/wrong-shard rejection) before any row enters formal evidence. Acceptance: only complete, merge-validated shard sets can be promoted into the formal ledger; incomplete or drifted sets fail closed.
